notes.note: Fix round 4 of the delivery-state change: another window's queue-change notice only re-projects (it no longer starts a flush, and a held copy listed from another window no longer counts as a waiting row); public outbox rows carry sendUnderWay only while the claiming renderer's Web Lock is held, so the list reads Sending only then and the bubble agrees; Discard… stays mounted and the shared confirmation takes and returns focus; the composer's confirmation opens as its own popover; the phone sheet's inline actions are a group of buttons; the accepted outbox note reads in sentence case and outbox text wraps and clamps to two lines. Updated the outbound dispatch Behavior paragraph: sendUnderWay is set only for an invoking row whose claiming renderer's Web Lock is held (publicTurns in outboundQueue.ts; an unknown or released lock is not), and the flush hook re-projects on subscribeRemoteChange without flushing, ignores heldElsewhere rows in its writable-with-waiting trigger, and re-projects every OWNER_RECHECK_MS while a row is sendUnderWay (useOutboundQueueFlush.ts). Checked against outboundQueueLiveReconcile.test.ts and useOutboundQueueFlush.test.ts.
